notes.title: "The Awakener:Forgotten Oath" Version 2.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Dear Awakeners,
The upcoming Version 2.4 update focuses on improving performance and reducing stuttering, especially during early gameplay interactions. Our goal is to provide a smoother and more immersive combat experience for all players.

Update Highlights:
1.New Precompilation Phase in Main Menu
The game now precompiles essential resources such as skill animations and effects during the main menu phase, reducing load time during actual combat.

2.Reduced Stutter on First Hit
Addressed issues where the first time a character’s skill hits an enemy would cause a noticeable stutter. Combat feedback is now more responsive.

3.Optimized First-Time Visual Effect Loads
Improved how visual effects are loaded the first time they appear, such as potion use or spell casting, reducing the delay and enhancing immersion.

4.Improved Initial Level Loading Performance
Reduced stuttering and load times when entering a map or level for the first time.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Feel free to share your thoughts with us on the community channels!

notes.title: New version of "The Awakener: Forgotten Oath" is out!
notes.notes:
Hello Awakeners,

version2.01 of "The Awakener: Forgotten Oath" is out now, we have adjusted many parts in the whole game including action, building, roguelike and so on.

According to the overall adjustment, we will return an equivalent amount of [Void Crystals] to those players already had this game based on their previous savings. We hope you can have better experience in the new version.

Of course, if you prefer the previous version, you could still play it by Steam test branch.(Right click on "The Awakener: Forgotten Oath" in the Steam game library, select the beta version in the attributes, enter the code: afoafo101010 in the private test, and select afo_ 1.0, you can enjoy the previous version)

Fllowing are more detailed updates:

Updates1:Optimized the skill upgrades and Artefacts, make the roguelike gameplay more enjoyable
·Skill upgrades will be randomly rewarded in room.
·Artefacts will  be randomly rewarded in room.
·Added types of skill upgrades and Artefacts, added into 10+ skills and 20+ Artefacts in one run.
·Added double Artefacts,  we suggest you trying more than 10 unique buildings like 【Twin Summoned Launcher】【Frozen Flow】【Twin Dragon】【SuperArmor】【Rapid Sword Aura】and so on.

Updates2:Optimized battle experience and game difficulty, make battles more enjoyable.
·Enriched enemy types in the first round game
·Added armor for normal enemies during close combats
·Increased HP and attack of enemies.
·Increased the enemies' desire to attack.
·Enhanced the visual effect of attack warning.

Other Updates:
·Adjusted the frequency of appearances for each room and prices.
·You could get Void Crystals after each level.
·Reduced the HP and potion function within each level.
·Merged two kinds of currencies.
·Redesigned the terrain of the second and third levels for adapting to fast-paced battles.
·Redesigned the building system out of levels, and now you can use the obtained Void Crystals for more efficient weapon and skill upgrades, or it can also be used to unlock new characters.

Optimization updates:
·Optimized the attack range decision of some elites and bosses
·Optimized the AI for some enemies.
·Optimized the UI for enemy attack warning.
·Optimized the game feel with Defense actions.
·Merged two kinds of currencies.
·Optimized  various function entrances sign and positions in the Animitta.
·Removed traps in levels.
·Optimized the shake amplitude of the screen.

Adjusted Holy Relics building
·Optimized Holy Relics  building structure.
·Reduced a large number of redundant Holy Relics and improved the cost-effectiveness of Holy Relics.

Artefacts Adjustment
·Improved the function of Artefacts
·Added one slot position for Artefacts
·Added more Artefacts:Dragon Edge、Laser Crystal、Flame Shield Charge、Darkhole、Windhole、Drifting Thunder、Surrounding Knives、Lightning Spell、Earthquake Spell、Aurablade、Bless of Rage、Bless of Precision、Frozen Moon、Frost Blade。
·Added levels for all Artefacts, each of them has 3 levels

Level selection updates:
·Deleted the rooms out of game levels.
·Added rooms for skill buildings.
·Adjusted the rewards in artefact rooms
·Adjusted the rewards in  Holy Relic rooms
·Modified the types of merchandise sold in the shops to artifacts, skills, and holly relics.
·Removed artifacts upgrades and item purchases in shops.

Skills Adjustments
·Adds new default skills to Fighter:Air Slash Sword、Shield Rush
·Adds new default skills to Blade Dancer:Twinmoon Slash、Bee Sting
·Adds new default skills to Vanguard：Annular Strike、Spearend Thrust
·Added new optional skills to Fighter:Ground Breaker、Shockwave Shield、Hound Stab、Whirl Slash
·Added new optional attack to Fighter:Owlbear combo
·Added new optional attack to Blade Dancer:Dread Raven Combo
·Added new optional attack to Vanguard：Snake Swipe Combo

Player operation adjustment
·Air Dodge exists at the beginning.
·Removed the perspective assistance during attack.
·Added iframe when knocked off.
·After being knocked off, players can stand up faster after falling to the ground

Game World Difficulty Adjustment
·Reduced the number of levels from 10 to 5.
·Modified the difficulty of each curse level.

notes.title: The Awakener: Forgotten Oath Update Plan
notes.notes:
Hello Awakeners,

We've received a wealth of feedback and suggestions since the game's launch. Thanks to all of you, we're committed to continually improving the game.

Updates include:
1. Added full-screen resolution support
2. Introduced Controller Invert function
3. Adjusted game difficulty
4. Reduced the requirements to unlock world difficulty levels
5. Optimized character ground movement decisions by the in-game system

Additionally, we plan to keep updating the game in the future. The launch is just the beginning for a small team like TANER GAMES. Time constraints and other factors mean we must carefully plan our updates. We will release a detailed plan about future updates, including new careers and characters.

Thank you for your support!
